title: Falling for Anahid, the only girl he proposed to
summary: He calls marrying violinist Anahid the luckiest thing, and says she taught him classical music.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: She was the first girl you ever wanted to marry.
Yep. I never proposed to anybody else.

Oh yeah, the luckiest thing that ever happened to me, because she’s the most marvelous person I’ve ever known, in addition to being a magnificent musician and a magnificent wife. She’s even a magnificent cook. The fact that I was familiar with the general idea of certain phases of contemporary classical music made our marriage, I think, even better, because I began to know more
